_comment: ADVERSARIAL SET for the four Leitpunkte of g04_homeoffice_thread. Every `de` string was written to represent what a competent B2 learner plausibly writes, NOT to pass or fail any particular detector. `expect` is the semantic judgement a teacher would make: does this text address that Leitpunkt? Cases are grouped by the trap they set. HELD-OUT cases (held_out: true) were written after the rules were finished and scored exactly once, without tuning — the tuned score is overfit by construction and only the held-out score is evidence.
